items.text: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to making technical corrections to eliminate the restrictions upon transferring for members of the New York state teachers' retirement system
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5135

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the education law, in relation to
making technical corrections to eliminate the restrictions upon
transferring for members of the New York state teachers' retirement
system

 PURPOSE OF THE BILL :

This bill proposes to make technical corrections to Education Law
Section 522, Subdivision 2, consistent with Chapter 438 of the Laws of
2016 amending the Retirement and Social Security Law Section 43.
Uniform with Chapter 438, this bill eliminates the requirement for
members to provide one year's notice, prior to withdrawing
contributions, of their intent to transfer. It further removes the
requirement for members to acquire three years of service in the
second system in order to receive the benefit based on their combined
salary and service of both retirement systems.

 SUMMARY AND JUSTIFICATION :

Chapter 438 was proposed with the intent to simplify the
administration of transfers between the pension systems in New York.
This proposed legislation maintains consistency with the similar
provisions of applicable law and captures the changes made by Chapter
438 by making parallel amendments to language in the Education Law.
Additionally, and for background purposes, the one year requirement
for members to notify of their intent to transfer and the three year
requirement for members to provide service in the second system to
receive a combined benefit were set in place in accordance with the
transfer of reserves between retirement systems. Pursuant to Chapter
647 of the Laws of 2004 the transfer of reserves between retirement
systems was eliminated. Without the transfer of reserves between
retirement systems these requirements are no longer necessary.

This proposed amendment will make the technical changes necessary for
consistent application of the transfer provisions among retirement
systems and, as other provisions have been subsequently amended, its
implementation will not alter the intent of the law. In an effort to
remove any disparity amongst the tiers and maintain consistency with
the statutes, and for the other reasons stated, the Retirement Board
respectfully submits this bill to the Legislature for their
consideration.

 EFFECTIVE DATE OF THE BILL :

This act shall take effect immediately and shall be deemed to have
been in full force and effect on and after November 14, 2016.

 BUDGETARY IMPLICATIONS OF THE BILL :

The annual cost to the employers of members of the New York State
Teachers' Retirement System for this benefit is estimated to be
negligible if this bill is enacted.
